Around [[3626 BBY]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''merchant''' bought a [[Nexu claw pendant]] from the [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] [[Rida Denru]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Later, an individual was sent to retrieve the pendant by the [[Horizon's Razor]], Denru's [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]]. The merchant challenged the individual for a duel in exchange for the pendant.
